newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Wrightson sells bloodstock subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Wrightson sells bloodstock subsidiary.

text.p: Wrightson Limited said on Monday it had agreed to sell its subsidiary, Wrightson Bloodstock Ltd, for an undisclosed sum.
The buyers are prominent bloodstock breeders Philip and Peter Vela.

Wrightson chief executive Greg Kay said developments in the bloodstock industry made breeder interest a more natural owner of the business, based at the world-class Karaka Sales Centre, south of Auckland.
"While the bloodstock operation continues to be a successful one for Wrightson, it no longer has the same strategic fit with our broader business objectives," Kay said.
"Other parties are better placed to add further value to the operation as we concentrate on growth in other parts of our business."
The New Zealand National Yearling Sales in January are the next major event for Wrightson Bloodstock and both parties expressed strong confidence in the success of the sales.
